card.title: Sd Kfz 250/9
card.text: Gets +2 attack until end of turn when you draw a card.
card.flavorText: The Sd Kfz 250/9 was a reconnaissance variant of Germany’s light armored half-track series, introduced to replace wheeled scout cars which struggled on the Eastern Front. Based on the Sd Kfz 250 chassis, the 250/9 featured a fully enclosed roof and a small turret mounting a 2 cm KwK 38 autocannon alongside a coaxial MG34 machine gun. This turret was initially adapted from the Sd Kfz 222 armored car. Prototype vehicles were tested on the Eastern Front in mid-1942. Following favorable feedback, series production began in late 1942 using the earlier Ausf. A chassis. These early models remained in use until early 1944. From spring 1944, production shifted to the improved Ausf. B chassis. These later variants were equipped with a new Hängelafette 38 turret, which had reinforced 30 mm frontal armor and was shared with the 8-wheeled Sd Kfz 234/1. The Sd Kfz 250/9 offered better off-road mobility and protection than its predecessors, making it a valuable asset for Panzer reconnaissance units operating in challenging conditions across Europe and the Soviet Union.
